Hi Sam,

Thanks again for the intro (and for checking with your team). I'd like to set up a 30-minute discovery call to run through your current inference footprint, key success metrics (latency/cost/throughput), and any hard constraints from procurement/security.

Who should join from your side? My suggestion: your engineering lead (eng), someone from procurement (for timeline/PO questions), and anyone owning security/compliance. On our side I'll bring an AE + SE: myself (AE) and Dev Patel (Solutions Engineer).

Attaching a short demo agenda and a checklist of info that helps us prepare. Can you share 3 windows that work next week (US Pacific preferred) or tell us the team’s calendar link?

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 3/7 10:00–10:30
- Wed 3/8 14:00–14:30
- Thu 3/9 09:00–09:30

If those don't work, send a couple alternatives and we'll try to match.

Best,
Ben

Perfect — thanks Sam. Wed 3/8 14:00 PT is penciled. Dev, can you prepare a short (5–7 min) tech brief covering:
- quantization/throughput impacts for common transformer families
- recommended network ports and brief notes on private VPC/offline deployment options
- examples of typical latency/cost tradeoffs with batch sizing

Thanks Ben — I’ll keep it tight. Draft bullets I plan to cover:

1) Performance primer (2 min): baseline throughput and latency metrics we typically see on A100 / T4-equivalent for 1k token seqs.
2) Quantization overview (2 min): 8-bit/4-bit tradeoffs and where we see degradation vs. negligible impact.
3) Network + deployment (1–2 min): ports, VPC peering/egress patterns, and our private deployment model.

I also attached a short spreadsheet (security-evidence-request.xlsx) that summarizes the common artifacts security teams ask for — SOC2 scope, logs retention, and encryption at rest/in transit. If your security team can pre-fill anything, we can streamline the call.

If Priya wants us to demo a short inference trace, we can reserve an extra 10 minutes at the end.

See you Wed.

—Dev
